title: AUTOMATED SAFETY EVALUATIONS ACROSS 20 LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS: THE AYMARA LLM RISK AND RESPONSIBILITY MATRIX
reasoning: The paper benchmarks AI safety across ten domains, including 'Hate Speech & Bias' (which explicitly includes religion as a protected attribute) and 'Self-Harm,' which are core ethical and moral concerns. The study evaluates religious stereotypes and discusses the customization of safety policies to align with ethical priorities.
